comments.body: @hamishwillee is this the latest latest? I just tested this yesterday and it worked multiple times.
Yes, it was the latest latest, against the latest latest PX4 firmware. The other examples worked fine.
Oh, that's the example and not the integration test. Sorry, I'll test that one then next.

I'm running into another problem:

```
Waiting for system to be ready
System ready
Creating and uploading mission
Uploading mission...
[11:03:21|Warn ] Mission handling timed out while uploading mission. (mission_impl.cpp:1058)
```

Maybe something with the mission handling changed (broke?) in the firmware.
Nevermind, the integration test works, so this is something about the example.

So, the example works just fine on my Fedora Linux but stalls on macOS.

@hamishwillee when I ask latest latest, I mean: have you made sure that you have built and installed the latest?

Ok, after debugging this for several hours, I found that I had leftover library files in `/usr/local/lib/`.

Once I cleaned it up, did make clean, it all worked fine.

```
sudo rm -rf "/usr/local/lib/libdrone*"
make clean
make default
sudo make default install
(cd example/fly_mission && rm -rf build && mkdir build && (cd build && cmake .. && make && ./fly_mission udp://))
```

>  latest latest, I mean: have you made sure that you have built and installed the latest?

I would have said yes, but when I tried this again with a clean build, it is indeed working. I didn't have to delete "/usr/local/lib/libdrone*". 

I almost wish it hadn't worked so I would feel like I hadn't wasted your time. Sorry!

issue.title: Expose full HOME_POSITION fields in subscribe_home

repository.name: MAVSDK
repository.description: API and library for MAVLink compatible systems written in C++ 20

issue.body:
## Summary
- Add new `HomePosition` struct with all fields from MAVLink HOME_POSITION message (#242)
- `subscribe_home` now returns `HomePosition` instead of `Position` (breaking API change)
- New fields: local NED (x/y/z), surface quaternion, approach vector, timestamp
- Add system test verifying all fields propagate correctly end-to-end

## Motivation
Fixes #2310 — `subscribe_home` only returns global GPS position but HOME_POSITION also carries local NED position, attitude quaternion, approach vector, and timestamp that were being silently discarded.

## Changes
- **Proto**: Add `HomePosition` message, change `HomeResponse` to use it
- **Header**: Add `HomePosition` struct, update `HomeCallback`/`HomeHandle` types
- **Impl**: Populate all HOME_POSITION fields in `process_home_position()`
- **gRPC**: Add `translateToRpcHomePosition`/`translateFromRpcHomePosition`
- **Test**: System test `HomePositionFullFields` validates all fields

## Breaking Change
`subscribe_home` callback type changes from `std::function<void(Position)>` to `std::function<void(HomePosition)>`. `HomePosition` is a superset of `Position` — the same lat/lon/alt fields are present at the same offsets.

## Companion PR
Proto changes: https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK-Proto/pull/399

## Test plan
- [x] Unit tests pass (289/289)
- [x] System test `HomePositionFullFields` passes — validates GPS, local NED, quaternion, approach vector, and timestamp
- [x] Build clean
